D1.title: 按订单分装教具并交付载料碗
D1.prompt: Place the two ordered red cubes into the yellow bowl in sequence. Put the specified blue cube into the mint bowl and deliver that bowl.

D2.title: 擦除交班白板的指定栏
D2.prompt: Erase the black check in the left column, preserve the right-hand mark, and park the marker.

D3.title: 为周转空瓶配盖封存
D3.prompt: Cap the open bottle with its matching threaded lid and leave it upright in the finished-goods area.

D4.title: 将客房方巾对折两次并收纳
D4.prompt: Fold the orange-loop towel twice at right angles and place the four-layer bundle in the storage area.

D5.title: 为离线检修工位插接日志盘
D5.prompt: Insert the black-and-red service drive into the flanged USB-A socket. Leave the joined parts resting in the work area.
